text: 近日，北京经开区正式印发全市首个新材料产业专项政策——《北京经济技术开发区关于加快新材料产业创新发展的若干措施》，明确先进基础材料、关键战略材料、前沿创新材料三大支持方向，围绕坚持创新驱动、畅通成果转化、深化双向赋能、强化要素支撑四个方面，提出12条重点支持措施，全力打造新材料产业高地。（证券时报）
text_en: Recently, the Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area officially issued the city's first special policy for the new materials industry, the "Several Measures of the Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area on Accelerating the Innovative Development of the New Materials Industry," specifying three major support directions: advanced basic materials, key strategic materials, and frontier innovative materials. Focusing on four aspects - adhering to innovation-driven development, facilitating the transformation of achievements, deepening two-way empowerment, and strengthening factor support - it proposed 12 key support measures to build a highland for the new materials industry. (Securities Times)
